Today, we celebrate the resurrection and the hope we have in our risen Savior! 

“The angel said to the women, ‘Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified. He is not here; he has risen, just as he said.’” (Matt. 28: 5-6) 

Happy Easter from the Johnson family.

Today, Christians around the world observe Good Friday.

We call it “Good Friday” because what seemed like the darkest day led to the greatest gift of all time — the resurrection of Jesus Christ, His triumph over sin and death, and the gift of eternal life offered freely to all who believe.

Congratulations to the Artemis II crew and the @NASA team on this successful launch. Our nation is watching proudly, and we pray for a safe and successful mission. 

The sky’s the limit for America’s Golden Age under President Trump’s leadership.


NASA (@NASA)

Liftoff.

The Artemis II mission launched from @NASAKennedy at 6:35pm ET (2235 UTC), propelling four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.

Wishing our Jewish community across the nation and around the world a meaningful Passover, and a safe and peaceful celebration.

Chag Sameach!

My joint statement with @LeaderJohnThune on DHS funding:

We appreciate and share the President’s determination to once and for all bring an end to the Democrat DHS shutdown.
 
In the coming days, Republicans in the Senate and House will be following through on the President’s directive by fully funding the entire Department of Homeland Security on two parallel tracks: through the appropriations process and through the reconciliation process.

Praying for the safety and success of the Artemis II crew and @NASA as they undertake a mission that will carry humanity farther into space than we have gone in over half a century.

I had the privilege of hosting these courageous pioneers at the State of the Union earlier this year.

Americans are watching proudly as our Golden Age reaches new heights! 🚀

This year, taxpayers will receive $191 billion in additional refunds and have $30 billion less withheld from their paychecks — all thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts.

Real money. Real people. Make no mistake: every single Democrat voted against you getting more money in your pocket — BUT — Republicans delivered.


Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47)

It is my distinct honor and great privilege to invite His Majesty King Charles III, The King of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, to address a Joint Meeting of Congress.

Our two nations share one of the most consequential partnerships in history, and together we will mark the historic milestone of America’s 250th year of independence.

I, myself, am the product of an unplanned pregnancy, and I stand with @theisabelb — and with the enduring belief that every person is made in God‘s image, and thus every life holds inestimable dignity, value, and purpose.

House Republicans will have NO part in zeroing out CBP and ICE.

Democrats need to STOP protecting criminal illegal aliens and playing games with real people’s lives.

We must support Homeland Security, get our government running again, and PAY our hardworking law enforcement who keep us safe.

House Republicans have voted to fully fund DHS **four times** and will keep fighting for a solution.

Video

The Working Families Tax Cuts were written for hardworking Americans who deserve to keep more of what they earn.

I caught up with Uber Eats driver Bob Mitchell, one of the millions of Americans who benefits from the No Tax on Tips provision. 

Every single Democrat voted against allowing workers to keep more of their money. 

Republicans are delivering real relief for the American people.

Sheridan Gorman should still be alive today. 

We lift her loved ones up in prayer and continue our fight for common sense laws that protect Americans from these violent illegal aliens. 

Democrats refuse to say her name because their policies led to her death. Now, they've caused the LONGEST shutdown in history — dangerously refusing to fund Homeland Security to protect criminal illegal aliens who have killed innocent Americans like Sheridan.

Democrats have shut down our Department of Homeland Security to protect EVIL people like this who shoved an 83 year-old veteran onto subway tracks and died.

Democrats are OBSESSED with the welfare of criminal illegal aliens over our veterans. It’s insane.
